_about: The '6-week project' template a scenario names with project.projectType. FDE-bench sends it in setup (docs/sut-protocol.md); a SUT applies it, or its own equivalent, when it creates the project. {provider} and {customer} stand for the scenario's provider firm and customer names. offsetDays count from the kickoff Monday (day 0); they are timing hints, not due dates (only an agreed timeline dates actions).
name: 6-week project
description: Scoping (Week 0), build (Weeks 1-2), two UAT rounds (Weeks 3-4), handoff (Week 5).

defaultActions.task: Demo the MVP and align on UAT
